hypothesis.claim: The exact original source-built CMIX package with only CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192 bound in a clean environment preserves payload, archive, inverse, and repeats and can constrain PPM residency below the 9000000 KiB 100M engineering limit.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject execution-envelope authority on any package, payload, control/treatment archive, treatment repeat, inverse, lease, telemetry, memory, disk, CPU-affinity, runtime-projection, phase, or cleanup failure. Absence of externally sampled PPM drops is inconclusive, not algorithmic falsification.

changedMechanism: Set the original package's existing runtime PPM residency threshold to 8192 MiB; do not change the executable, model, coder, archive format, source, or package assets.
invariants: The treatment and control use the same exact original 468481-byte packaged compressor and 23002-byte head.
The treatment codec environment contains only PATH, KH_BITLSTM32, GAMMA_RESOURCE_PHASE_MARKERS, and CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192; the control omits only CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB.
The first runnable gate is exactly canonical opening 1000000 bytes; exact opening 100000000 is the only larger gate and is reject-only.
Every encode and decode stage owns the current managed exclusive lease and strict resource-guard contract for its entire process lifetime.
Scratch is disk-backed, result/scratch/cgroup/lease paths are unique, and no existing artifact is overwritten.

Optional probability/state witnesses may corroborate the gate but are not required: authority is limited to the exact same binary/source contract plus exact payload, control/treatment archive, treatment repeat, and inverse evidence.
The frozen cmix_obias_memory_safe_parent_q0_v1 source/program is conditional-successor provenance only and is not an execution dependency or score entry.
Externally sampled smaps drop/regrowth events are bounded diagnostics only because the existing 5000-byte purge cadence may evade a five-second sampling interval.
The active HORIZON job blocks all corpus execution but not read-only validation.

controls.definition: Exact original package in a clean environment with its default 9216 MiB PPM-RSS threshold.
The byte-identical original package in the same clean environment with CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192.
A second independent E encode must reproduce both payload and self-extracting archive byte-for-byte.
If optional probability/state witnesses are supplied, malformed, wrong-population, wrong-package, or unequal witnesses fail closed.

population.selection: Exact first 1000000 bytes of canonical enwik9; a pass authorizes only the separately selected exact opening-100000000 reject-only gate.
population.coordinate: Original raw byte offset and the exact deterministic transformed/coded sequence produced by the bound package.

availableInformation: the exact current and prior input bytes available to the unchanged original CMIX package
current process RSS read by the existing PPM runtime control
forbiddenInformation: future corpus bytes or decoder-unavailable state
patched malloc-trim or phase-marker executable behavior
inference of probability identity from payload identity alone
claiming direct purge-call counts from externally sampled smaps

measurements.definition: Control and treatment bind the same source/package, exact payload and archive, treatment repeat, and exact inverse.
Control and treatment coded payload artifacts agree exactly.
Two treatment payload and archive artifacts agree exactly.
The treatment archive restores the exact selected raw prefix.
Maximum guarded process-tree RSS over every stage.
At 100M, treatment maximum process-tree RSS is strictly below 9000000 KiB; this is true by scope at 1M.
Maximum cgroup-v2 memory peak over every stage.
Maximum allocated temporary disk observed over result and scratch roots.
Treatment-A encode elapsed seconds divided by matched control encode elapsed seconds.
Matched control/treatment tree peaks, PPM mapping maxima when observable, faults, and IO are recorded.
Treatment has a lower externally sampled PPM maximum or tree peak than control; false is inconclusive and is not a kill predicate.
Bounded external smaps drop count; not a direct purge-call count and not a promotion or kill predicate.
Official score total of compressor, head, archive, and exact 69-byte compression plus 31-byte decompression command text; evidence-bundle bytes are separate zero-score accounting.
At 100M, linear full-scope encode/decode projections with a frozen 1.25 reserve remain below the Geekbench-bound phase limit; reject-only, never qualification.
